mapper.select: SELECT id,project_code,project_name FROM pm_project WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY project_name,id
SELECT * FROM tm_test_announcement WHERE AND pinned=1 ORDER BY pinned_at DESC,id DESC
SELECT * FROM tm_test_announcement WHERE ORDER BY published_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id,title,REGEXP_REPLACE(content_html,'<[^>]*>','') AS summary,pinned,pinned_at,published_by,(SELECT u.display_name FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id=tm_test_announcement.published_by AND u.tenant_id=tm_test_announcement.tenant_id AND u.deleted=0) AS publisher_name,published_at,last_edited_by,last_edited_at FROM tm_test_announcement WHERE ORDER BY pinned DESC,pinned_at DESC,published_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{size}
SELECT * FROM tm_test_announcement WHERE id=#{id} AND
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tm_test_announcement(id,tenant_id,test_domain,project_id,title,content_html,pinned,pinned_at,published_by) VALUES(#{id},#{tenantId},#{domain},#{projectId},#{title},#{html},#{pinned},CASE WHEN #{pinned}=1 THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END,#{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE tm_test_announcement SET title=#{title},content_html=#{html},pinned=#{pinned},pinned_at=CASE WHEN #{pinned}=1 AND pinned=0 THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHEN #{pinned}=0 THEN NULL ELSE pinned_at END,last_edited_by=#{userId},last_edited_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}

UPDATE tm_test_announcement SET pinned=#{pinned},pinned_at=CASE WHEN #{pinned}=1 THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END,last_edited_by=#{userId},last_edited_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT attachment_id FROM tm_test_announcement_attachment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND announcement_id=#{id} AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE tm_test_announcement_attachment SET deleted=1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND announcement_id=#{id} AND attachment_id=#{attachmentId}
UPDATE tm_test_announcement_attachment SET deleted=1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND announcement_id=#{id}
UPDATE tm_test_announcement SET deleted=1,last_edited_by=#{userId},last_edited_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_announcement_attachment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND announcement_id=#{id} AND deleted=0

SELECT a.attachment_id AS id,f.file_name AS fileName,f.file_size AS fileSize,f.content_type AS contentType,f.created_at AS createdAt,a.attachment_type AS attachmentType FROM tm_test_announcement_attachment a JOIN att_file f ON f.id=a.attachment_id AND f.tenant_id=a.tenant_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.announcement_id=#{id} AND a.deleted=0 ORDER BY a.sort_no,a.id
